content: Creighton University Medical Center Saint Joseph Hospital, located in North Omaha, Nebraska, USA, is a healthcare facility currently operated by Tenet Healthcare, though it remains under the ownership of Creighton University. The hospital was originally established on September 25, 1870, by the Sisters of Mercy. In 1880, the Sisters of St. Francis assumed management of the institution. Over the years, the hospital has undergone several name changes, starting as Creighton Memorial, then Saint Joseph Hospital, followed by Saint Joseph Hospital at Creighton University Medical Center, and is now known as Creighton University Medical Center. It serves as the teaching hospital for Creighton University's College of Pharmacy, College of Nursing, College of Dentistry, and College of Health Careers. In 2007, the Marvel Comics superhero Iron Man was depicted as receiving medical treatment at Creighton University Medical Center following a battle. This event was part of an ongoing storyline within the comic series.
